{{Quote|It's an Alliance signal receiver. When the light starts blinking, it means we're close to a broadcasting base-homing device.|A Rebel operative in the Roche asteroid field|<ref name="SFS" />}}
A '''base-homing device''' broadcasted a signal to indicate the location of a hidden installation. The broadcast could be picked up by a [[Signal receiver/Legends|signal receiver]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] bases, such as the [[Command Base]] in the [[Roche asteroid field]], used a base-homing device to allow Alliance [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to find their location.<ref name="SFS" />
